owned_changes.description: Verify required independent reviewer passes from retained native execution evidence before accepting complete coverage; bind evidence to the reviewer and pinned session and preserve incomplete execution diagnostics.

Add passive private workflow usage attribution across lifecycle invocations, helper stages, native and command provider attempts, review coverage and checkpoint reuse; retain explicit unknown host measurements and completion status separately from reviewer quality statistics.

Separate preparation analyst instructions from downstream worker guidance and validate worker contracts through existing bounded preparation correction, preserving read-only authorization and immutable evidence.

Typed cleanup evidence, owned preparation refresh, read-only architecture evaluator contracts, recipient-specific nested packets, concurrent role checkpoints, bounded same-cycle infrastructure recovery, exact-identity cleanup proofs, persistent CI deadlines and diagnostic timing spans.
Keep oversized JSON correction requests within the serialized transport budget using complete private evidence files, preserving one correction, validation and diagnostic recovery.
Handle ordinary text choice evidence conservatively during review reconciliation while retaining exact Decisions duplicate checks, protected-source fingerprints and file errors.

Add optional native Codex profile-v2 bindings with actual owned-workspace execution capture, separately retained supplied/derived evidence, conservative typed relocation identity, native effective settings and drift guards; protect required metadata credentials through source-grounded child environment channels, retain unchanged file-backed values, use bounded short-guard verification and safe owned helper group cleanup, and extend offline/correspondence regressions.

Recognize narrowly matched empty GitHub CLI no-checks responses so existing exact-head CI grace and deadline handling can run; retain errors, retry policy and non-success absence outcomes with controlled regression coverage.

Offline evaluation of normalized workflow traces with synthetic policy controls and a real-trace normalization and adoption guide. Reports are diagnostic-only and establish no real-agent compliance or resource savings.

Report every cleanup comparison category key mismatch before validating verdicts so the single correction can repair complete source, field and decision enumeration; retain rejected diagnostics and unchanged retry budgets.

Explicit provider selection for internal read-only analysis, preserving calling-host identity, correction budgets and configured reviewers with private provider provenance and quota recovery guidance.
Bounded recovery for allocated review cycles with durable evidence of no reviewer dispatch, preserving failed sessions, substantive review budgets and final-tree coverage guards.
Recorded agreement bindings and local freshness checks across preparation, review, work and completion gates, with bounded private discussion evidence and actionable extraction recovery.
Typed readiness, scheduling and publication preparation evidence with conservative governing-field handling and deterministic live PR metadata revalidation.

Reduce preparation prompts and model-facing metadata while preserving governing analysis and evidence; add opt-in compact reviewer handoffs with active Decisions, assigned guidance, fingerprinted originals and unchanged validation gates.

Clarify agent prompts and handoffs with direct language, distinct reply phases and validator passes, explicit JSON drafting examples, and structured completion instructions while preserving authorization, evidence requirements and workflow limits.

Bound live CI classification with compact immediate terminal and phase reporting in the waiter and completion gate, workflow-scoped named-failure discovery, verified historical attempt reuse, deadline-aware registry locks, report parsing and issue-proof matching, validated Go event types and linear grouping, iterative nested JUnit totals, scalable target mapping, retained partial attempt diagnostics and regression coverage preserving exact-head, attempt and issue guards.

Precise cleanup comparison index diagnostics, explicit required response identities, durable private rejected exchanges and correction budgets, with recovery guidance and guard-preservation regressions.

Shared PR iteration waiting and communication policy, nested handoff delivery and behavioral long-wait acceptance examples; brief host-required pending updates remain independent of evidence collection, provider calls and CI observation.

Recognize Codex usage-limit diagnostics as provider exhaustion while preserving authentication precedence and bounded redacted diagnostics, with classifier, Codex transport and reviewer-status regression coverage.

Private architecture catalogs with architect, architecture reviewer and independent exception enforcer roles for both hosts; scoped rule packets, user-owned exception policy and mandatory preparation/review/completion evidence. Shared instruction-source guidance separates review evidence from active workflow requirements.

Concurrent configured PR reviewers with immutable per-reviewer handoffs, isolated telemetry, deterministic aggregation and interruption-safe mandatory checkpoints, with offline command-provider regression coverage.

Recover interrupted Decisions publication outcomes after head/title changes, route PR reads by full host URL, and keep offline legacy reads free of migration writes, with recovery, host-routing and persistence regression coverage.
Tool-owned lifecycle entry, typed recovery actions, durable publication intents and receipts, guarded branch/review/CI publication, and shorter host procedures.
Persistent Decisions storage, per-PR transactions, retained agreement evidence and independent-run recovery regressions.
Incremental preparation, conclusion graph, immutable evidence lineage, refresh validation and regression coverage.

Fresh workflow metadata contracts: consistent plugin versions, revision-checked Decisions and publication ownership, engineering compatibility identity, durable captures and isolated checkouts, host guidance and regression coverage.
